note: Product catalog for the testnet market: twelve widely known consumer products, then six phone cases as a secondary category. Each product's reference price is the manufacturer's US list price as of Oct 2026, written into this file: a fixed value, not a live feed, and street prices can differ. The six phone cases carry a fixed catalog reference price instead, not a list price. Prices on the market come only from sealed-bid batch auctions between scripted bots, settled in a test token. The shape is what a ProductSource (for example a Google Merchant API adapter) must return.
